sentences.text: The documents do not state a processing fee for gold loans.

The gold-loan document says gold loans shall be governed by the Gold Loan Operational Guidelines of the Bank, while the ₹400 processing-fee amount appears in the Home Loan Agreement and in the UCB Directions table, without tying that amount to gold loans.
